args.notes: Spec: 16-axis motor control, 32 requests per 1us tick, all results back within 0.44us p99. Need throughput >= 32 Msps and tight batch latency. Pipelined families (pipelined, pipelined_m) are the natural fit for high throughput with small area; unrolled_k with k>=32 could also meet the batch deadline but may cost area. Keep max_abs_err <= 2^-12 (accuracy_bits >= 12). Minimize luts+ffs.
